author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೊಳೆತುಮನ ನಾರುತಿರೆ ಸುವಿಚಾರ ಒಳಬರದು
ಕಳೆಯುವುದು ಯೋಚಿಸುವ ಪರಿಪರಿಯ ಭಾವ
ಸೆಳೆಯುವುದು ನಗುಮೊಗವು ಆದರಾತಿಥ್ಯಗಳ
ಬೆಳೆಸುವುದು ಗೌರವವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When the mind rots and reeks, no good thought can enter;
it drives away every thoughtful feeling;
a smiling face draws warmth and hospitality;
it makes respect grow, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A mind that has gone sour lets no good thought in and crowds out every gentle feeling. A cheerful face, on the other hand, draws people's warmth and welcome, and earns lasting respect.
